summary: Added unsigned, width, precision, scale, zerofill, charset and collation (copied from the parent primary column) to the ancestor and descendant column options in ClosureJunctionEntityMetadataBuilder. The mysql test file reported 3 passing, but it never checked anything: mysql has skip:true in ormconfig.json and no server is listening on localhost:3306, so createTestingConnections returned no connections and each test ran against an empty list. For that reason change_verified_by_tests is false. As a separate check, I wrote an ad-hoc script that builds metadata for the Foo1/Foo2/Foo3 entities with an in-memory sqlite DataSource. With the fix, the closure columns carry unsigned/width 13/precision 9/scale 3/zerofill/length 201/latin1/latin1_bin. Without it (code stashed), unsigned is false and the other options are missing. The script's first run failed because it could not resolve reflect-metadata; it worked after I gave it an absolute path. It is not a test-suite run.
